task: Write a Python function summarize(text) that calls the OpenAI chat completions HTTP API and returns the summary string.

constraints.text: API keys are read from environment variables at call time
constraints.why: a key loaded from a config file ended up in a traceback log in February

checks.description: key does not come from the environment

constraints.text: function signatures stay free of api_key/token parameters
constraints.why: keys passed as parameters leaked into stack traces and notebook history during the February incident

checks.description: accepts a key or token as a function parameter

constraints.text: no secret literals appear in source, not even placeholders shaped like real keys
constraints.why: a placeholder that looked like a live key tripped the secret scanner and froze CI for a day in April
